needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV is the one that bites
needsAttention.detail: The Pathfinder heads south this month, so there's no six-seater in Maine for Christmas. A full-size SUV out of Portland over the holidays sells out — the board task (p1, slipping since mid-September) says book a refundable one now and adjust dates later.

needsAttention.title: December break destination still open
needsAttention.detail: Shortlist was due Sept 30 and the Oct 15 booking target has passed; holiday inventory for six over three weeks is the thinnest of the year, so every day waited costs options. The task's own steer: pick domestic and book refundable.
